biological_interpretation: HSF1 maintains a compact constitutive HSPH1/HSP90 support layer in a restricted set of mature neuronal classes, and direct Hsp90ab1 or Hsf4 perturbation does not simply phenocopy Hsf1 loss.
caveats: Hsf1 target mRNA did not pass FDR in any class despite mostly negative log-fold changes.
Only mRNA abundance was measured, not inducible heat-shock capacity or HSP protein levels.
exact_observed_result: Hsf1 perturbation consistently reduced basal chaperone transcripts in selected neurons: 151 TH lowered Hsph1, Hsp90aa1, Hsp90ab1 and Ahsa2 at FDR < 0.05; 155 MB lowered Hsph1, Rsrp1 and Stip1; 052 Pvalb lowered Rsrp1 and Ahsa2; and 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut had a single FDR-supported Hsp90aa1 decrease.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior work supports the broad molecular function of the perturbed target or complex, while the atlas result refines the affected brain cell type and RNA-output module.

resolved_evidence.description: Direct measurement of Hsf1 mRNA after Hsf1 guides showed consistent but multiple-testing-weak target knockdown.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Hsf1 transcript row present in all 22 Hsf1-perturbed cell types; logFC was negative in 21/22, median -0.311, range -0.589 to +0.136; 13/22 nominal p<0.05; 0/22 FDR<0.05.

resolved_evidence.description: Strongest Hsf1 response, dominated by downregulated HSP90/HSPH1-associated chaperone genes plus Rsrp1 and Mat2a.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 246 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 6 genes at FDR<0.05: Hsph1 logFC -0.484 FDR 1.69e-08, Hsp90aa1 -0.282 FDR 2.85e-04, Rsrp1 -0.175 FDR 8.06e-04, Hsp90ab1 -0.345 FDR 8.96e-04, Mat2a -0.234 FDR 0.00737, Ahsa2 -0.294 FDR 0.00827; Hsf1 logFC -0.299, p=4.92e-04, FDR 0.680.

resolved_evidence.description: Midbrain glutamatergic Hsf1 perturbation significantly lowered Hsph1, Rsrp1, and the Hsp70-Hsp90 co-chaperone Stip1.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 233 perturbed cells versus 20353 controls; Hsph1 logFC -0.599 FDR 2.50e-04; Rsrp1 -0.161 FDR 0.00169; Stip1 -0.388 FDR 0.00583; Hsf1 -0.337, p=1.83e-04, FDR 0.799.

resolved_evidence.description: Pvalb interneurons showed a smaller but FDR-supported Hsf1 response centered on Rsrp1 and Ahsa2, with nominal downregulation of core heat-shock genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 158 perturbed cells versus 13710 controls; Rsrp1 logFC -0.195 FDR 0.00252; Ahsa2 -0.590 FDR 0.00471; Hsph1 -0.370 p=8.39e-04 FDR 1.0; Hsp90aa1 -0.270 p=0.00132 FDR 1.0; Hsf1 -0.347 p=0.00392 FDR 1.0.

resolved_evidence.description: A restricted hypothalamic glutamatergic group had a single FDR-significant Hsp90aa1 decrease after Hsf1 perturbation.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 107 perturbed cells versus 8681 controls; Hsp90aa1 logFC -0.439, score -4.798, p=1.60e-06, FDR 0.0275; Mat2a p=2.93e-04, Hsph1 p=8.22e-04, and Hsf1 p=0.0229 were nominal but not FDR-significant.

resolved_evidence.description: Hsph1 was the most directionally recurrent chaperone transcript in the Hsf1 dataset.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Hsph1 was lower after Hsf1 perturbation in 22/22 measured cell types; median logFC -0.442; 9/22 nominal p<0.001; FDR<0.05 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut.

resolved_evidence.description: Direct knockdown of the HSF1-regulated Hsp90ab1 chaperone was much stronger at the Hsp90ab1 mRNA level than Hsf1 knockdown was at Hsf1 mRNA.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Hsp90ab1 guides lowered Hsp90ab1 at FDR<0.05 in 15/23 groups; examples were 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut logFC -1.417 FDR 2.31e-32, 155 MB Glut -1.496 FDR 2.75e-28, 052 Pvalb Gaba -1.349 FDR 1.39e-21, and 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut -1.422 FDR 9.64e-09.

resolved_evidence.description: Hsp90ab1 loss did not phenocopy Hsf1 loss and produced weak opposite-direction changes in several HSF1-responsive HSP transcripts.
resolved_evidence.statistics: After Hsp90ab1 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Hsp90ab1 logFC was -1.417 FDR 2.31e-32, while Hsp90aa1 was weakly higher at logFC +0.147 p=0.0136 FDR 1.0, Hsph1 +0.152 p=0.101 FDR 1.0, Ahsa2 +0.103 p=0.141 FDR 1.0, and Stip1 +0.120 p=0.127 FDR 1.0; top-200 Hsf1 signature correlations with Hsp90ab1 were 0.0669 in 151, 0.0686 in 155, 0.0884 in 052, and 0.141 in 110.

support.support_note: Exact log2 fold changes, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet for this grounding pass; score-vector correlations and perturbed/control cell counts are resolved from the structured report evidence.

title: Hsf1 loss selectively suppresses a basal HSPH1/HSP90 chaperone module
